result.title: Uncertainty-Driven Efficient Communication for UAV-Based Collaborative Perception
result.summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based collaborative perception enables multiple agents to share complementary perceptual information, overcoming limitations such as occlusion and limited sensing range. Communication efficiency is a critical bottleneck, as UAVs operate under stringent bandwidth and computational constraints. However, existing spatial selection methods focus predominantly on foreground regions to reduce missed detections, neglecting perceptually ambiguous regions and leaving false detections unresolved. We propose UCP, an uncertainty-driven framework that characterizes collaborative value through observational uncertainty, identifying sensor-limited regions, and discriminative uncertainty, capturing model-level ambiguity near the decision boundary. These estimates drive spatial request and supply maps for efficient inter-agent communication, and the received messages are aggregated via U-Fusion, an uncertainty-guided cross-attention module. Experiments on three benchmarks across 3D object detection and trajectory prediction demonstrate a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off with high interpretability and strong generalizability.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UCP 框架，用观测不确定性（传感器受限区域）与判别不确定性（决策边界附近的模型歧义）驱动空间请求/供给图，并通过不确定性引导的交叉注意力 U-Fusion 聚合消息，在 3D 检测与轨迹预测上改善带宽-性能权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 以不确定性筛选应传递的视觉证据并决定获取区域，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」式获取决策提供线索；但任务是协同感知而非推理，需核查其选择机制是否具备状态化、可停止的推理语义。
